Infrastructure Requirements

This engine integrates with your existing shared-docker-infra.

Required Services

| Service | Purpose | Required For | |---------|---------|--------------| | LiteLLM | LLM inference gateway | All workflows | | Postgres | Vector storage + embeddings | RAG, Telegram | | Neo4j | Knowledge graph | RAG, Telegram | | MongoDB | Media files | Telegram | | MinIO | Large file storage | Telegram |

Start Infrastructure

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
cd ~/Documents/programs/shared-docker-infra

# Start core services (required for all workflows)
make core-up

# Start databases (depends on workflow)
make db-up

Service Endpoints

| Service | Domain | Purpose | |---------|--------|---------| | LiteLLM | litellm.local | All LLM inference | | Postgres | localhost:5433 | Vector storage | | Neo4j | localhost:7687 | Knowledge graph | | MongoDB | localhost:27017 | Media files | | MinIO | localhost:9000 | Object storage |

See shared-docker-infra/docs/ for full documentation.

Environment Variables

Set these before running workflows:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
# LiteLLM
export LITELLM_BASE_URL=http://litellm.local/v1
export LITELLM_API_KEY=sk-litellm-master

# Postgres
export CONTEXT_POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5433/deep_research

# Neo4j
export NEO4J_URI=bolt://localhost:7687
export NEO4J_PASSWORD=your_password

# MongoDB
export MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017/telegram

# MinIO
export MINIO_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000
export MINIO_ACCESS_KEY=minio
export MINIO_SECRET_KEY=minio_password

Workflow-Specific Requirements

| Workflow | LiteLLM | Postgres | Neo4j | MongoDB | MinIO | |----------|---------|----------|-------|---------|-------| | RAG Research | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | - | - | | PDF Summarizer | ✓ | - | - | - | - | | Telegram Ingest | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Skill Generator | ✓ | - | - | - | - |

Verify Infrastructure

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
# Test LiteLLM
curl http://litellm.local/v1/models

# Test Postgres
psql -h localhost -p 5433 -U postgres -c "SELECT 1"

# Test Neo4j
cypher-shell -u neo4j -p your_password "RETURN 1"

# Test MongoDB
mongosh mongodb://localhost:27017 --eval "db.runCommand({ping: 1})"

# Test MinIO
curl http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live
